name: Appsfruit Page & Post Cloner
author: Appsfruit

sections.description:
Appsfruit Page & Post Cloner is a simple yet powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to clone or duplicate WordPress pages, posts, and custom post types with just one click.

Features

  • Add a “Clone” link in the WordPress Posts and Pages admin listing (next to Edit, Trash links)
  • Create a draft copy of any post, page, or custom post type
  • Copy all original content, featured image, categories, tags, and meta fields
  • Works with both Gutenberg and Classic Editor
  • Full support for Custom Post Types
  • Settings page to choose which post types the cloning feature applies to
  • No Coding Required: Change the settings without touching a single line of code
  • Lightweight: Designed to be lightweight and optimized for performance

Usage

  1. Navigate to Settings > Appsfruit Page & Post Cloner in your WordPress admin
  2. Select which post types should have the clone functionality
  3. Navigate to your posts, pages, or custom post types list
  4. Hover over any item and click the “Clone” link
  5. A draft copy will be created and you’ll be redirected to the edit screen

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the appsfruit-page-post-cloner folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Appsfruit Page & Post Cloner to configure which post types should have the clone functionality
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with Gutenberg?

Yes, this plugin works with both Gutenberg and Classic Editor.

Can I clone custom post types?

Yes, you can clone any custom post type. Just enable them in the plugin settings.

Will the clone have the same categories, tags, and custom fields?

Yes, the plugin copies all taxonomies (categories, tags) and custom fields from the original post.

Is there a performance impact?

No, this plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance. It only adds the clone functionality where needed and does not add any significant load to your site.
